items.desc: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
items.readme: agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries. No install:** `npx agent-browser open example.c

items.desc: Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account.
items.readme: LocalThings Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account.** LocalThings connects Home Assistant to Samsung washers, dryers, refrigerators, air conditioners, ovens and other appliances that work with the SmartThings app. It talks to each appliance on your local network. Updates are fast.** Appliances that support push send changes as they happen. LocalThings checks the rest every 30 seconds. It works without the internet.** After setup, LocalThings never contacts Samsung's servers. Your data stays home.** LocalThings sends nothing to Samsung. items.desc: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
items.readme: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) Run a managed Kubernetes service on your own NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.** NVIDIA Kubernetes® Engine (NVKE) provides the management plane that platform teams install to create and operate Kubernetes clusters for their customers. Each workload cluster has its own Kubernetes control plane, etcd and node pools. You operate the NVKE management plane; your customers use their clusters through the Kubernetes API and `kubectl`. Preview:** NVKE is available as a preview. APIs, configuration and behavior can change between releases, and we do not recommend NVKE for production workloads.
